beats.story: On day . . . whatever, I wake up and go to pour myself cereal, but the box is empty. I manage to find a package of oatmeal I'd purchased years ago when I really thought I'd be a wake-up-early-and-chop-bananas-into-things kind of gal. I manage it down despite its uninspired texture. And I even manage to brush my teeth and change from one pair of sweats into another before a loud knock sounds on my door. I tiptoe toward the peephole.
beats.story_cn: 第……随便哪天吧，醒来去倒麦片，结果盒子空了。翻出一包多年前买的燕麦片——那时我真心以为自己能成为"早起切香蕉拌早餐"那种自律女青年。硬着头皮往下咽，尽管这玩意儿口感寡淡得像嚼纸板。接着居然还刷了牙，把一条运动裤换成另一条同款运动裤时，敲门声炸雷般响起。我踮脚凑到猫眼前。

beats.story: The large Warhammer is clear on his hoodie. I groan. "Hey, Jolene?" What the hell is he doing here? After the last devastating look he gave me, I never thought I'd see him again, certainly not in my hallway. I click open the door but keep the chain intact, lest he see the mess of clothes, food wrappers, and undies. Even before I became a goblin, the state of my apartment wasn't winning any prizes, but now it could probably be featured on Investigation Discovery. He's balancing a precarious two-coffee-and-two-donut-bag situation. There's a hesitant softness in his gaze.
beats.story_cn: 卫衣上醒目的战锤图案。我暗骂一声。"嘿，乔琳？"他他妈来这儿干嘛？自从他甩给我那个万念俱灰的眼神后，我从没想过会再见到他，尤其不该在我家走廊。我拉开门栓但留着门链，免得他看见屋里堆积如山的衣服、食品包装袋和内衣——早在我沦为摆烂怪之前，这公寓就不配拿整洁奖，现在简直能上《重案实录》当犯罪现场。他正艰难保持着咖啡两杯、甜甜圈两袋的危险平衡。目光里带着犹豫的温柔。

I'm extremely fired, so I think that makes me dead in your eyes." Cliff almost smiles, before he clocks my crossed arms and it falls flat. "I'm glad you're still you. And I'm sorry to show up like this. I tried texting first. I just came to drop off some letters.
beats.story_cn: "你的甜甜圈是根汁汽水味的。"我清了清嗓子，"不明白人力资源部怎么还搞上门服务。不过我已经不是你的员工了。我被开得彻彻底底，在你眼里大概算个死人吧。"克利夫几乎要笑，瞥见我交叉的双臂时笑容瞬间冻结，"很高兴你还是你。这样登门实在抱歉，本来发了短信，我主要是来送几封信……"

beats.story: A few people at work wanted to get in touch with you." "I'm pretty sure getting fired means I'm not involved in Supershops business anymore," I remind him. "But I'm not here on official Supershops business." His gaze shifts down. He lowers his voice. "Could you let me in? Your neighbor Miley is listening." He has no business being here, seeing the shit show I worked so hard to keep exclusive. But I'm not the one who deserves to be mad. I was the one who hurt him. "You get used to it." I stare Cliff down but pull the chain.
beats.story_cn: “公司里有些人想联系你。”“我相当肯定，被炒鱿鱼就意味着我跟‘超级商店’再没半毛钱关系了，”我提醒他。“但我今天来可不是为了‘超级商店’的公务。”他眼神低垂，压低声音：“能让我进去吗？你的邻居麦莉在偷听。”他本不该踏足此地，目睹我曾费尽心机想让其与外界隔绝的这摊烂事。但我才是那个没资格发脾气的人。是我伤他在先。“你总得习惯的。”我直视着克里夫，却还是拉开了门链。

beats.story: It clatters against the door before opening fully. He's being very careful not to look at anything but my eyes as he makes his way around the clutter. Some coffee spills onto his wrist from the overfilled cup and he winces. "I can take the coffee off your hands, lest you get more hurt," I say. He pretty much jumps over himself to give me the cup. It's too apparent how shaky my hand is as I take it. He pulls a manila envelope from his hoodie pocket. "The letters." A wave of opposing feelings crash inside me.
beats.story_cn: 门先是哐啷一响，才被完全推开。他小心翼翼地绕过杂物，目光只敢停留在我的眼睛上。满溢的咖啡洒了点在他手腕上，他疼得缩了一下。“咖啡我帮你拿着吧，免得你再烫着。”我说。他几乎是跳起来把杯子塞给我。我接杯时手抖得太过明显。他从连帽衫口袋里掏出一个牛皮纸信封。“那些信件。”一股矛盾的情绪在我体内猛烈翻涌。

I keep my face even as I take the envelope and toss it onto my shoe rack. "Thanks." He reaches into his hoodie again. "Also, you left a lot of stuff at your desk. The stuff I determined is more personal -- " "Is that all?" I interrupt, and look pointedly at my mess of boots and junk on the floor. "I'm pretty busy here." "I won't take too much of your time, but . .

"But after you left, when I was at that office without you, cleaning your desk in front of everyone, I realized I know you." He closes his eyes briefly. "I did what I had to do as an HR rep. But I'm here to let you explain. As a friend." But I was the shittiest friend. "What is there to say?" I almost laugh. "It's all true.
beats.story_cn: “我受伤了，也很愤怒。”负罪感拽着我的目光垂向地面。他深吸一口气，神色软化。“但你离开后，当我在那间没了你的办公室里，当众清理你的桌面时，我意识到我了解你。”他短暂闭眼。“作为HR我做了必须做的事。但现在我以朋友的身份来听你解释。”而我却是最糟糕的朋友。“还有什么可说的？”我几乎笑出声。“全是事实。”

I squeeze my hands together, willing my heart to stay as solid as wood. I can't do this. But at least I can finally dispel myself of some of the guilt that's been roiling in my belly. I can give him the apology he deserves.

beats.story: "Look, Cliff, I'm really so sorry about the spying. It was terrible of me. I really mean that. Like, what kind of person does that?" He nods and waits. "That day you changed the settings on my computer, I tried to tell you at first. But I was embarrassed, because people were saying things about me I didn't want you to see. And then I realized the layoffs were coming and I thought, Why not, if it's already there? Everything was already so screwed up, I figured it wouldn't hurt to give myself a tiny leg up." I hold in a breath.
beats.story_cn: "听着，克利夫，对于监视的事我真的很抱歉。那样做太卑劣了。我是真心实意的。说真的，这算哪门子人啊？"他点点头，等着下文。"那天你修改我电脑设置时，我本想告诉你。但我太难堪了，因为当时有些关于我的闲言碎语，我不想让你看见。后来裁员风声紧了，我就想，既然记录都在那儿了，何不顺水推舟？反正一切早乱成一团，我心想稍微争取点优势也无伤大雅。"我屏住呼吸。

beats.story: His eyes widen. "I know things are messy, but we brought out a lot of good in each other too. I don't want to end things like this. Maybe we can stay in touch?" "You still want to be friends?" He rubs his beard, and the scent of his soap carries toward me. It would all be so blissful to just be there with him, instead of alone here forever. But he continues. "We could try. As long as, this time, we're completely honest with each other." But all the flutters come crashing down -- it hits like a brick wall.
beats.story_cn: 他瞳孔微张：“我知道现在一团糟，但我们确实激发过彼此好的一面。我不想就这样结束。也许……我们还能保持联系？”“你还想做朋友？”他搓了搓胡子，皂角的气息飘过来。就这样待在他身边，而非永远孤独地站在这里，本该是多幸福的事。可他继续说：“我们可以试试。只要这次，彼此完全坦诚。”但所有悸动瞬间崩塌——一堵砖墙轰然砸下。

beats.story_cn: “你值得那些美好——你值得幸福。” 他的话揪着我的心，让我喉咙发紧。克里夫倾身靠近些。“答应我，别永远惩罚自己？” 我点点头，把所有情绪都压在心底。沉默片刻，我说：“那我答应你，我会试试，行吗？” 他露出一个悲伤的微笑。“既然这样，我祝你前程似锦，一切顺利。” 我也对他微笑。“你也是。” 当他走向我的门口，即将永远离开我时，我知道我是真心的。我祝他一切都好。
